sources.title: 思南时光｜风景如画香山路
sources.creator: 上海黄浦
sources.direct_description: 香山路9号是一幢两层楼的小洋房，原来是《解放日报》的集体宿舍楼，如今，这里已作民居使用。
sources.use: Textual corroboration of the named residence; the #7 museum is separately discussed.

observations.visible: White plaster wall beneath red pitched tiles. On the larger western dormer the summit of the short gable stands over two separated window openings; paired horizontal drying rails project beneath them. The smaller eastern gable has a single dark opening. The upper main wall has unevenly spaced apertures.

The same unequal pair of gables, the western paired openings, the small eastern opening, and the adjacent main-storey windows are carried by the same red-tiled slope. Summer plane-tree branches obscure parts of both gables.
The larger dormer and repeated upper-storey openings can still be distinguished behind a foreground plane tree.

extent: Visible street-side roof and facade. No interior or plot reconstructed from the register, POI or photographer metadata.
